 "rationale": "Small gains give beta of about 0.85, so the closed-loop BW is close to the loop UGF. The target is GBW ~ 380 MHz with Cc of about 90 fF. Budget: Iref + 20 uA tail + ~40 uA output stage is about 70 uA, roughly 126 uW. Rf is about 10k, which keeps the summing-node pole near 1 GHz. A wide, weak-inversion NMOS pair gives about 0.3 V of tail headroom. The PMOS-mirror node at about 0.75 V biases the PMOS CS output. The divider is pre-corrected for finite loop gain."}

PARAMS = {
    "W1":   (6.0, 2.0, 20.0),     # NMOS input pair width [um]
    "L1":   (0.3, 0.15, 0.6),     # input pair L
    "Wp":   (5.0, 2.0, 15.0),     # PMOS mirror load width (per side, 10 uA)
    "Lp":   (0.3, 0.15, 0.6),     # PMOS L (loads and output device)
    "Wref": (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),      # NMOS bias reference width at Iref
    "Ln":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),      # NMOS bias L
    "k6":   (4.0, 3.0, 4.5),      # output-stage current / half-tail current
    "Cc":   (90e-15, 40e-15, 250e-15),
    "rzk":  (2.5, 0.5, 8.0),      # Rz = rzk / gm6
    "Rf":   (10e3, 6e3, 25e3),
}

def _solve(lt, dev, W, L, Id, vds, vsb=0.0):
    lo, hi = 0.05, 1.75
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lt.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds, vsb)["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    v = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    return v, lt.op(dev, W, L, v, vds, vsb)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD, VCM = 1.8, 0.9
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 0.5e-12)
    g1t, g2t = 0.1571, 0.01797

    Itail = 20e-6
    Ih = Itail / 2
    k6 = p["k6"]
    I6 = k6 * Ih

    W1, L1, Wp, Lp = p["W1"], p["L1"], p["Wp"], p["Lp"]
    Wref, Ln = p["Wref"], p["Ln"]
    W5 = Wref * Itail / iref          # tail mirror (width ratio, same L)
    W7 = Wref * I6 / iref             # output sink mirror
    W6 = Wp * k6                      # PMOS output, same density as loads

    # bias reference
    vref, oref = _solve(lut, "n", Wref, Ln, iref, 0.7)
    # PMOS load diode
    vsg3, o3 = _solve(lut, "p", Wp, Lp, Ih, 1.05)
    v1 = VDD - vsg3
    # input pair, iterate tail node
    vt = 0.3
    for _ in range(6):
        vgs1, o1 = _solve(lut, "n", W1, L1, Ih, max(v1 - vt, 0.1), vt)
        vt = VCM - vgs1
    o5 = lut.op("n", W5, Ln, vref, max(vt, 0.05))
    o6 = lut.op("p", W6, Lp, vsg3, VDD - VCM)
    o7 = lut.op("n", W7, Ln, vref, VCM)
    o4 = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg3, VDD - v1)

    Rf = p["Rf"]
    gm1, gm6 = o1["gm"], o6["gm"]
    A1 = gm1 / (o1["gds"] + o4["gds"])
    A2 = gm6 / (o6["gds"] + o7["gds"] + 1.0 / Rf)
    A = A1 * A2
    beta = 1.0 / (1.0 + g1t + g2t)
    corr = 1.0 + 1.0 / (A * beta)
    R1 = Rf / (g1t * corr)
    R2 = Rf / (g2t * corr)
    beta = 1.0 / (1.0 + Rf / R1 + Rf / R2)

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Rz = p["rzk"] / gm6
    C1 = o6["cgg"] + 0.3 * o4["cgg"] + 0.2 * o1["cgg"]
    GBW = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (C1 * CL + Cc * (C1 + CL)) / (2 * PI)
    Rn = 1.0 / (1.0 / Rf + 1.0 / R1 + 1.0 / R2)
    pin = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rn * (o1["cgg"] + 5e-15))
    fu = GBW * beta
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(fu / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(fu / pin))
    bw = fu * (1.25 if pm < 65 else 1.0)

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.M("M8", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wref, Ln)
    n.M("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W5, Ln)
    # first stage: inverting input = summing node "vn" on M1
    n.M("M1", "n1", "vn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.M("M2", "d2", "vcm", "tail", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.M("M3", "d2", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    n.M("M4", "n1", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    # second stage
    n.M("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W6, Lp)
    n.M("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W7, Ln)
    n.R("Rz", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "nz", "vout", Cc)
    # summer network
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "vn", R1)
    n.R("R2", "vin2", "vn", R2)
    n.R("Rf", "vn", "vout", Rf)

    power = VDD * (iref + Itail + I6)
    vos = (1.0 / beta) * 0.002
    return n, {"a1": -(Rf / R1) / (1 + 1 / (A * beta)),
               "a2": -(Rf / R2) / (1 + 1 / (A * beta)),
               "bw": bw, "power": power, "vout_offset": vos,
               "loop_gain_db": 20 * math.log10(A * beta), "pm_deg": pm,
               "gbw": GBW, "p2": p2, "vtail": vt, "v1": v1}
